messages:
lisa: Ok team — kickoff with Pegasus POC tomorrow 10am PT. Quick prep: final agenda, success criteria, security asks, and pricing Qs. Who's on the call from their side? @amir
amir: @lisa They confirmed 3 engineers + their CISO Anya. Asked about hosted vs dedicated recommendation and a token cost ballpark.
casey: Need to lock success criteria. Proposed: 1) 95% of prompts <300ms at ~50 rps, 2) semantic recall >=0.85 on their eval set, 3) embeddings-based retrieval MAP >=0.7, 4) end-to-end pipeline ingestion <30m for 1k docs.
hana: sending eval prompt set now (link in DM). Sec questionnaire in progress — they want SOC2 evidence, SSO (SAML), and audit logs.
security-bot: Sec questionnaire draft uploaded: https://files.redwood/pegasus/sec-questionnaire.pdf :paperclip:
amir: For pricing guidance: recommend starting hosted API for fast onramp, switch to Dedicated if steady throughput requires it. I'll estimate costs after we get avg tokens per turn and embedding call volume.
lisa: Agenda draft: intros (10m), scoping & success criteria (10m), ingestion demo (15m), run live prompts (20m), security checklist review (10m), next steps/timeline (5m). Additions?
casey: Add rollback/fallback plan and who has approval for model variant changes. Also confirm metrics to monitor for regressions.
lisa: noted. Also need to confirm PII handling: ask customer whether prompts contain PII and retention policy requirements.
hana: question for customer: do you require private VPC or on-prem? If yes, network onboarding will add lead time.
amir: Also ask which model families are allowed (open vs internally hosted). If they mandate internal-only, Private deployment lead time applies.
lisa: Assignments: amir — pricing estimate; hana — eval prompts & upload; casey — perf targets & load script; lisa — facilitation + sec points. Ack?
casey: ack
amir: ack
hana: ack
lisa: One more: they want an ops contact during POC. @mike from their infra team will be our day-to-day contact.
mike: (Pegasus) hi folks — correct. We'll provide infra + app eng. We'll need windowed access to logs and custom metrics (latency percentiles, error rates, token counts).
lisa: we'll enable per-route logging and give dashboard link. Ask them for the exact metrics they want.
security-bot: note: they requested encryption-at-rest with KMS and subprocessor list for legal. @elena please prep subprocessor doc.
elena: on it, will attach subprocessor/DP sharing doc to the questionnaire and flag any special clauses.
lisa: Timeline proposal: Day0 kickoff, Day1 ingestion + smoke, Day2 perf runs + eval, Day3 quality checks, Day4 wrap + decision. If VPC/network onboarding required, add 1–2 days buffer.
amir: agree — add buffer for network and SSO. Also, embeddings-heavy workloads may change cost by ~2x depending on reuse.
casey: load test plan snippet: ```
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 5m --script perf.js
``` Need sample payloads and auth token for perf env.
lisa: I'll update the shared doc and send calendar invites. Final asks for kickoff: customer to share sample prompts + labeled evals by EOD today. I'll chase.
mike: sending sample prompts and a small eval set now. Also: are embeddings billed separately?
amir: yes — embeddings are billed per-embedding unit. I'll include a detailed sheet showing token vs embedding unit cost and a few scenario estimates.
lisa: great. Anything else before I lock the agenda?
mike: can you confirm SLA around uptime for hosted POC? and data retention defaults?
lisa: We'll outline POC SLA (best-effort hosted, dedicated has SLA). Default retention is 30 days for POC environment; can be adjusted with a config or Private deployment.
casey: one more ops item — who owns the rollout if we need to swap model due to quality? we should list approvers in the doc.
elena: legal needs to review subprocessor list before signing anything with dedicated or private hosting.
lisa: thanks — I'll add owners and next steps. I'll DM invites and the updated playbook. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
